proofTiers.FOCUSED: Focused contract/unit/property tests plus affected package typecheck/build and diff checks.
proofTiers.REVIEW: FOCUSED evidence plus independent targeted review of the complete scenario seam.
proofTiers.DATABASE: REVIEW evidence plus bounded local PostgreSQL authorization, replay, rollback, privacy, cleanup, and concurrency schedules where applicable.
proofTiers.BROWSER: REVIEW evidence plus focused browser interaction, accessibility, selector, and reconnect coverage against the authoritative backend.
proofTiers.LOCAL_E2E: One complete final-source local lifecycle: generated artifacts, builds, typechecks, tests, database reset/seed/audit, transaction schedules, browser journeys, privacy, performance, and exact cleanup.

denominatorPolicy: Frozen after architecture approval; engineering subchecks do not change gate totals.
